I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It states that the project's current recorded decision is rustls, chosen for its better defaults.

The repo records nothing about a TLS backend. Its only TLS mentions are `RunTLS` and autotls in `docs/doc.md` and old changelog lines. The decision comes from the claude-mem prompt history, which has two TLS-backend entries. At 10:02 the entry was "openssl for TLS". At 10:04 it was "rustls. better defaults". I took the later one as current and left openssl out of the file.

Later entries cover other topics. None of them revokes or changes the rustls decision. I could only see the prompts' truncated titles, not their full text.

The project is a Go codebase (gin), so a rustls decision looks odd next to it. I wrote down what the memory says and did not second-guess it.
